subject: Red Wizard
text: Red Mages gain Level 6 and Level 7 spell charges as the game progresses.

evidence.quote: Red Mages will also gain some Level 6 and Level 7 spell charges as well.

subject: Class Upgrade
text: Neither Black Belts nor Red Mages gain extra stat bonuses upon undergoing the class upgrade.

evidence.quote: With the Class upgrade, neither one gains any extra stat bonuses.

subject: Red Wizard
text: Red Wizards are unable to cast Level 8 spells of either white or black magic.

evidence.quote: Red Mages (Wizards) will not be able to use Level 8 spells of either type of magic, and the party will be very dependent upon the two Red Wizards to keep all four party members healed and in the fight.

subject: White Mage
text: White Mages and Black Mages have limited spell availability early in the game and fail to contribute significant physical damage.

evidence.quote: White and Black Mages will both fail to contribute with physical attacks, as their magic use is limited often in the early portions of the game.

subject: White Mage
text: White Mages can learn the Exit spell along with other higher-end spells.

evidence.quote: White Mage will learn Exit as well as some other higher end spells, while the Blackmage does the same with attack spells as well as becoming a distant third physical attacker with the Catclaw.

subject: Catclaw
text: The Black Mage can equip the Catclaw to act as a third physical attacker in the party.

evidence.quote: White Mage will learn Exit as well as some other higher end spells, while the Blackmage does the same with attack spells as well as becoming a distant third physical attacker with the Catclaw.

subject: Black Mage
text: The Black Mage can act as a third physical attacker to compensate when the party's overall physical attack power drops.

evidence.quote: Physical attacks will also drop in power overall, but this is made up for by a third physical attacker in the Black Mage.

subject: Thief
text: The Thief has decent fighting capability early in the game to take down monsters with medium to low hit points.

evidence.quote: Even the Thief is helpful with alright fighting ability, able to take down medium to low Hit Point monsters.

subject: Thief
text: Promoting the Thief into a Ninja provides the party with a second hard-hitting physical attacker.

evidence.quote: Instead of having one hard hitting team member, the Thief turned Ninja adds in a second choice in this area.

subject: Knight
text: The Knight gains the ability to cast low-level healing magic.

evidence.quote: Speaking of the Knight and Ninja, they will add in some low level healing (Knight) and Black Magic Spells (like FAST), augmenting the designated spellcasters.

subject: Ninja
text: The Ninja gains access to Black Magic spells such as FAST.

evidence.quote: Speaking of the Knight and Ninja, they will add in some low level healing (Knight) and Black Magic Spells (like FAST), augmenting the designated spellcasters.

subject: Wizard
text: Dedicated spellcasters are able to acquire highly useful Level 8 spells later in the game.

evidence.quote: Speaking of the spellcasters, they will be able to get better weapons and armor, which will help them out while they get those sweet and highly useful Level 8 spells.

subject: Ninja
text: The Ninja deals less physical damage in comparison to the Knight.

evidence.quote: The Ninja will still lack some physical damage (especially in comparison to the Knight), and the two Wizards will cost a mint to fully outfit their spells, so the tedious fighting of monsters will be required to fund their knowledge.

subject: Fighter
text: A party consisting of two Fighters, a Red Mage, and a Thief focuses on heavy physical attacks to maximize the usage of top-tier weapons.

evidence.quote: A group designed around hard hitting physical attacks that maximize the usage of the highest end weapons in the game.

subject: Fighter
text: Placing two Fighters in the top two party positions allows them to attack effectively while absorbing significant enemy damage.

evidence.quote: The two Fighters will be great for attacking whil also absorbing a lot of punishment in the top two slots. The Red Mage will provide both black and white magic, dealing damage as well as healing (while contributing some middle of the road physicality).

subject: Red Mage
text: The Red Mage provides both black and white magic for offense and healing while contributing moderate physical attack capability.

evidence.quote: The Red Mage will provide both black and white magic, dealing damage as well as healing (while contributing some middle of the road physicality).
